fix_commit_message:
[base64] Check the length of the receiver

To perform `setFromHex` and `setFromBase64`, we should check the
length of the receiver and return early if it is 0.

Bug: 416302802, 416350780

agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix ec594c3ebe0d on top of intro d4c91a3691d0 via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (NullPointerDereference):  Root cause: The `Uint8ArrayPrototypeSetFromHex` function (introduced in commit d4c91a3) validates that the typed array is not detached or out-of-bounds but omits a check for `array_length == 0`. A zero-length typed array has no backing storage, so `DataPtr()` returns null. The subsequent call to `ArrayBufferFromHex` with this null output pointer causes a crash even though `output_length` is also 0.
